For anything other than bug reports and feature requests (performance, refactoring,
documentation, etc.), please describe the situation in as much detail as possible.

> **Note**: For general questions or support requests, please **search existing
> issues** first. We aim to keep the issue tracker focused on bugs and improvements;
> open-ended Q&A is best handled by reading the README and CONTRIBUTING guide.
